w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Gavel is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×3 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +75% HP, +36% damage, +1 in the pack.)
firstContext: 📱 The ring light BRIGHTENS — a new follower crawls out of the glow, phone-first, already filming. (1 followers. Each one sharpens the Ratio and drinks your favor.)
📼 RERUN ×3 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +75% HP, +36% damage, +1 in the pack.)
🏆 The Company did that. Not one hero — the whole shape of them, moving together. The village will hear this one with the name attached.
📺 The Company — You brought down The Paparazzo. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
firstContext: 🍽️ Elijah sets the sharing basket down by the fire instead of the pantry. "Full shelves don't need my little more."
✦ Ali has found something — Peacemaker's Voice. Days of diplomat and mediator side by side, and now they move as one. (peacemakers_voice: villager synergy discovered)
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
— DAY 114 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Cattail went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🛡️ Kathleen, Amina and Farid met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Kathleen, Amina, Farid are hurt.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
Elijah won't meet your eye. You said you'd help with the pantry run — and it never happened. Promises rot. (-15 trust)
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/7/6), with 1 wave-4 fought, 10 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Elijah Scott ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
